action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: Policy allows modifying a pending order's item to a different available variant of the same product after explicit user confirmation of all details, including price difference and refund method.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User confirmed switching the Bluetooth speaker to the cheapest blue variant ($271.89), was informed of the price difference and refund to PayPal, and gave explicit approval to proceed.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: The assistant verified the order was pending, presented all action details (item, price, refund, payment method), and obtained explicit user confirmation before executing the modification. The correct payment method was used for the refund, and only one tool call was made in the turn.
